visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dense, green forest with sunlight filtering through tall, straight coniferous trees. A Black man, the main character, is dressed in a bright orange long-sleeved safety shirt, grey work trousers, and a protective orange helmet with a black mesh face shield and ear defenders. He stands next to a tree trunk marked with a white band, holding a large white and orange STIHL chainsaw with both hands, his expression focused yet friendly as he looks towards the camera. (2) The camera transitions to an open hillside where numerous trees have already been felled, lying scattered across the terrain. The man is now holding a large wood-cutting axe over his shoulder, walking across the logs. The sky is overcast, providing flat, natural lighting that emphasizes the brown textures of the bark and the green foliage in the background. He gestures with the axe while speaking, his movements energetic and confident. (3) The perspective shifts to a medium shot of the man standing on the hillside, still holding the axe. He is interacting with off-screen individuals, his face lighting up with a wide smile and laughter. In the background, two other men in similar orange and grey workwear appear, standing among the fallen logs and sparse vegetation. The man continues to demonstrate the use of the axe, pointing towards the ground and back at his home country, his hand gestures large and expressive against the mountainous landscape.
